about: drawn after ARX's own photo of the X5 of 2023, the single-rail gripper (ARX5_beta images/image_6.png, 2026-11-12, and its neutral cut-out), and the assembly manual's two photos in white light: a black anodised motor can, flange, rail beam with its end stops and centre bridge, the ground steel guide rail as the one bright part, matte black fingers (the Library's part, HandUMI's printed tip).  The pinion's hub is hidden in every photo and is drawn black.  Three things are the project's own drawing, not the model's, which has no screw and no carriage and whose counterbores are open.  In the photo the gripper is closed and shows two of the rail's holes at each end: a black socket head in the outermost, and the next one as a plain dark disc (an empty hole in shadow or a head with no highlight: the photo does not tell); the four middle holes are hidden under the fingers.  So the two outermost holes hold a socket-head screw, a plain cylinder with a six-sided one for its socket (bodies/arx-x5/drawn-rail-screws.stl and drawn-rail-sockets.stl; at full opening, as here, they lie under the fingers' bases), and the six others a plain dark disc (drawn-rail-holes.stl), the four hidden ones assumed to be like their neighbour.  The red plastic end caps of the two linear carriages where the rail leaves each finger's base are plain boxes with the section of an MGN9C block, 20 x 8 mm, and its caps' 5 mm (drawn-caps-sensor.stl and drawn-caps-mate.stl; the mate's are see-through with their finger, as the carriage is a piece of the finger's link); the carriages' steel blocks lie inside the tips' bases here and are not drawn.  No rack, finger screw, cable, status light or lettering is modelled.

finger-black.evidence: the assembly manual's photo in white light and ARX5_beta image_6: the finger is the flattest and darkest black of the gripper, #14191a on its side face beside the motor can's #424647, with no highlight; at the base look's numbers its broad faces were #383839 to #3c3c3d, with these they read #2b2b2c to #333335, under the can's middle grey (#3e3f44), and its darkest strip #1f1f22, about the film beside it (#212225)

rail-ground.evidence: ARX5_beta image_6 and its neutral cut-out: the rail's top face is one even bright grey, #c8c8c8 to #d8d8d8, with no mirror image of the room in it (a ground face, not a polished one), over a darker side face; at the base look's numbers that face swung from #848689 at the home to the card's white where it mirrored the top softbox (#ecf0f4 on #f5f5f7); rougher and brighter it is #aeb0b2 over a #9b9d9f side at the home and #b3b6b8 to #d4d7d9 turned, about #e6e6e6 at its brightest (the reviews of 2026-11-12).  At roughness 0.75 that top face was one flat tone at the homes, #adafb2 to #aeb0b2, with no lustre at all (the verification of 2026-11-13: the user asked for metal's lustre); at 0.45 it runs lighter along its length at the home, from the shade of the side face to a soft streak, as ground steel does, and a quarter turn round it mirrors the softbox near white over its dark side face, a polished highlight on a part still outlined (the light greys at #e8e8e8 or over 9 % of them there, 1.3 % at 0.75)

can-blasted.evidence: the assembly manual's photos in white light and ARX5_beta image_6: the motor cans are bead-blasted black anodising, #424647 on the lit side with one broad soft highlight and no mirror image of the room; at the base look's numbers the can's flank mirrored the studio's flag at #14161c, darker than the film beside it (#212225); with these the can reads #222329 to #4e5054 at the home, #3e3f44 in the middle, and #1a1c21 in one narrow stripe when turned half round

screw-black-oxide.evidence: ARX5_beta image_6 and its cut-out: the socket head in the outermost hole at each end of the rail is black with a glint on its rim (#232323 to #4c4c4c in the cut-out, up to #cdcdcd in the glint) round a black socket

hole-dark.evidence: ARX5_beta image_6 and its cut-out: the second hole from each end of the rail is a plain dark disc with no rim and no glint (#1b1b1b to #2a2a2a in the cut-out), and the heads' sockets are black; drawn, a disc reads #2d2d2f in the bright rail

cap-red.evidence: ARX5_beta image_6: a red plastic end cap round the rail at the finger's base (the patch reads up to #d9afb0 in the stage light's glare, #4d2524 in its shade)
